items.title: 8.5.3 How to Protect Your Intellectual Property

source_refs.note: Topic 8.5.3 as printed (PDF 203, printed 200): the book's numbered list. The book prints no 8.5.1 or 8.5.2 (they appear as 8.4.1 and 8.4.2).

items: Patents: If you invent something new, apply for a patent through the Intellectual Property Organization of Pakistan (IPO Pakistan).
Trademarks: Register your brand name, logo, or slogan as a trademark to prevent others from using it.
Copyrights: Ensure your creative works are protected by registering them with the appropriate authority.
Trade Secrets: Keep valuable business information confidential and use legal agreements to protect it.
